columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: External tool outputs need an explicit memory-contamination boundary
columns.title_zh: 外部工具输出需要显式的记忆污染边界
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260821-009 with Skill 02 score 46/50. Standalone function outputs without call IDs are now treated as external context in injected, new and forked threads; when configured, that state can mark memory as polluted and disable reuse. The change exposes a precise Digital Employee governance boundary between execution evidence and durable memory rather than merely a storage optimization.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260821-009，Skill 02 评分 46/50。没有 call_id 的独立 Function Output 在注入、新建与 Fork Thread 中被明确视为外部上下文；在相应策略下，该状态可把 Memory 标记为污染并停止复用。该变更暴露的是执行证据与持久记忆之间的明确数字员工治理边界，而不仅是存储优化。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the exact conditions that classify standalone tool output as external context, the injected/new/forked thread paths, the memory-pollution state transition, Guardian transcript identity preservation, persistence/resume/compaction effects and regression tests. Do not generalize this into a claim that all tool output is unsafe or that memory is always disabled.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查独立 Tool Output 被判定为外部上下文的准确条件、注入/新建/Fork Thread 路径、Memory Pollution 状态迁移、Guardian Transcript 的工具身份保留、持久化/恢复/压缩影响及回归测试；不得泛化为“所有 Tool Output 都不安全”或“Memory 总会被禁用”。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Approval trust in A2A systems must bind to the approving principal, not the transport
columns.title_zh: A2A 系统的审批信任必须绑定批准主体，而不是传输通道
columns.source_zh: Google ADK 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260821-015 with Skill 02 score 46/50. The maintainer reverted a guard that discarded human tool confirmations merely because A2A transport metadata was present, explicitly noting that the rule was both overbroad and insufficient. This isolates a high-value architecture question: approval authority must be attributable to the approving principal, not inferred from the transport carrying the message.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260821-015，Skill 02 评分 46/50。维护者回退了一个仅因存在 A2A 传输元数据就丢弃人工工具确认的门禁，并明确指出该规则既过宽又不足。这形成一个高价值架构问题：审批权限必须可归因于实际批准主体，而不能从承载消息的传输通道推断。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the reverted guard path, the legitimate confirmation path it blocked, why transport metadata was overbroad and insufficient, which principal identity is available at approval time, the regression coverage and the remaining unresolved trust gap. Do not infer that A2A authentication or end-to-end human authorization is fully solved.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查被回退门禁的准确路径、它误阻的合法确认路径、为何传输元数据既过宽又不足、审批时可获得哪些主体身份、回归覆盖以及仍未解决的信任缺口；不得推断 A2A 认证或端到端人工授权已经完整解决。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Project MCP helpers need both trust admission and credential isolation
columns.title_zh: 项目 MCP Helper 同时需要信任准入与凭据隔离
columns.source_zh: Anthropic Claude Code 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260821-020 with Skill 02 score 46/50. Project MCP headersHelper and inline MCP configuration can cause local helper execution and derived request headers. Requiring accepted Folder Trust while stripping inherited credential environment variables establishes two distinct and testable engineering boundaries: code-admission authority and ambient-secret isolation.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260821-020，Skill 02 评分 46/50。项目级 MCP headersHelper 与 Inline MCP 配置可能触发本地 Helper 执行并派生请求 Header。先要求接受 Folder Trust，再剥离继承的 Credential 环境变量，形成两个彼此独立且可测试的工程边界：代码执行准入与环境秘密隔离。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify helper scope precedence, the Folder Trust gate, exactly which inherited credential variables are removed, execution-directory rules for higher scopes, inline-server behavior, failure semantics and regression tests. Do not infer a stronger sandbox or secret-isolation guarantee beyond the demonstrated trust and environment boundaries.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查 Helper Scope 优先级、Folder Trust 门禁、准确剥离哪些继承 Credential 变量、高层级 Helper 的执行目录规则、Inline Server 行为、失败语义与回归测试；不得推断超出已证明 Trust 与 Environment 边界的更强 Sandbox 或秘密隔离保证。
